project: Statistical Mechanics within Optimizing Heterogeneous-Agent General Equilibrium
central_question: Can statistical-mechanical mechanisms be embedded in heterogeneous-agent general equilibrium with individual optimization, rational expectations and market clearing, before introducing New Keynesian nominal rigidity?
ordering_principle: Economic feasibility first, computational representation second, separate statistical-mechanical economic mechanisms from analytical diagnostics, nominal rigidity last.
economic_requirements: rational-consistent aggregate forecasts conditional on information
goods labor asset and credit market clearing
individual and aggregate budget and balance sheet accounting
verified existence and selection for multiple equilibria
no maximum entropy without an invariant-measure derivation

stages.title: Agent-Based Econophysics as an Equilibrium Computation Method
Optimal Kinetic Exchange and Boltzmann Dynamics (Yakovenko)
Ising-Type Social Interactions from Optimal Choices
Bouchaud-Inspired Firm Fragility with Optimal Firms
Minority Game and Strategic Financial Trading (Challet)
Random Matrix Diagnostics of Endogenous Correlations
New Keynesian Integration after General-Equilibrium Compatibility

criteria: A named economic mechanism is accepted only after optimality, RE and full equilibrium have been demonstrated or a concrete failure is recorded.

implementation.caveat: Finite-N market clearing with endogenous prices and aggregate stochastic RE not yet implemented.
